PR: Allow default entrypoints definition [closed; labels kind/enhancement, size/M, area/server]
### What does this PR do?

~~Add defaultEntryPoints setting, like the setting Traefik v1 had. The defaultEntryPoints has no effect on UDP routers. To keep it simple, I only implemented the HTTP/TCP part, and leaving the UDP to a future enhancement when it will eventually be requested.~~

~~**Edit**: Adds `--entrypoints.<name>.defaultset` setting (unlike the root `defaultEntryPoints` setting Traefik v1 had).~~

~~**Edit 2**: Adds `--entrypoints.<name>.explicitUseOnly` setting (unlike the root `defaul…

setting Traefik v1 had).~~

**Edit 2**: Adds `--entrypoints.<name>.asDefault` setting (unlike the root `defaultEntryPoints` setting Traefik v1 had).

The settings works like follows:

- By default, all entrypoints are included in the "default entrypoints" (old behavior)
- If any entrypoint are flagged with the new `asDefault: true` config then only those with `asDefault: true` are used by default when no entrypoints are set for a route (e.g in an IngressRoute)
